images.filename: ZION CHURCH IN LEONE, AMERICAN SAMOA.jpg
images.caption: The Village of Leone is the second largest settlement on Tutuila and once served as the Polynesian capital of the island. It was also the landing site of the first missionary, John Williams, who arrived in 1832. This church has a memorial to him directly in front. Wikipedia has a link to Leone but only a very brief mention of this town of some importance. This church is one of the most impressive on the island and a very historically significant although not listed on the National Register.
images.alt: The Village of Leone is the second largest settlement on Tutuila and once served as the Polynesian capital of the island.
